check.question: For every team existing at the end of March 31, 2026, return its ID and number of open or pending tickets it owned then, including zero.
check.sql:
WITH cutoff(cutoff_at) AS (SELECT '2026-04-01 00:00:00'),
created AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT e.ticket_id
  FROM ticket_events e CROSS JOIN cutoff
  WHERE e.event_type = 'created' AND e.occurred_at < cutoff.cutoff_at
),
last_status AS (
  SELECT x.ticket_id, x.to_status
  FROM (
    SELECT e.ticket_id, s.to_status,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY e.ticket_id ORDER BY e.occurred_at DESC, e.seq DESC) AS rn
    FROM ticket_events e
    JOIN ticket_status_events s ON s.event_id = e.event_id
    CROSS JOIN cutoff
    WHERE e.occurred_at < cutoff.cutoff_at
  ) x
  WHERE x.rn = 1
),
last_team AS (
  SELECT x.ticket_id, x.to_team_id
  FROM (
    SELECT e.ticket_id, a.to_team_id,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY e.ticket_id ORDER BY e.occurred_at DESC, e.seq DESC) AS rn
    FROM ticket_events e
    JOIN ticket_assignment_events a ON a.event_id = e.event_id
    CROSS JOIN cutoff
    WHERE e.occurred_at < cutoff.cutoff_at
  ) x
  WHERE x.rn = 1
),
state AS (
  SELECT c.ticket_id, ls.to_status, lt.to_team_id
  FROM created c
  JOIN last_status ls ON ls.ticket_id = c.ticket_id
  JOIN last_team lt ON lt.ticket_id = c.ticket_id
)
SELECT t.team_id,
       SUM(CASE WHEN ss.counts_as_backlog = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS backlog_count
FROM teams t
CROSS JOIN cutoff
LEFT JOIN state s ON s.to_team_id = t.team_id
LEFT JOIN ticket_statuses ss ON ss.status_code = s.to_status
WHERE t.created_at < cutoff.cutoff_at
GROUP BY t.team_id
ORDER BY t.team_id;

check.witness: Ticket 2 is transferred from team 10 to team 50 at exactly 2026-04-01 00:00:00 (event 202), and ticket 1 closes at that same instant (event 103, pending->closed). The March cutoff is exclusive (occurred_at < '2026-04-01 00:00:00'), so team 10 keeps ticket 2 as open and ticket 1 stays pending: team 10 = tickets {1,2,3,4,5,6} = 6, team 20 = tickets {7,8,9,10,11} = 5, team 30 = tickets {12,13,14,15} = 4, team 40 = tickets {16,17,18,19} = 4, and team 50 (created 2026-01-01, no March tickets) = 0. The wrong inclusive '<=' cutoff replays the 2026-04-01 00:00:00 events: ticket 1 becomes closed (team 10 loses it) and ticket 2 moves to team 50 as open (ticket 2's open->closed->open pair at the same timestamp ends open), yielding team 10 = 4 and team 50 = 1. Ticket 3's events at 2026-03-10 10:00:00 (seq 3,4,5) replay to open, keeping it in team 10's backlog. Hand-replayed March states: t1 pending@10, t2 open@10, t3 open@10, t4 open@10, t5 open@10, t6 open@10, t7-t11 open@20, t12-t15 open@30, t16-t19 open@40.
